article.title: Composition of National Commission.
article.content:
54Composition of National Commission.

Section 54  ·  Chapter IV  ·  pages 25–26 of the Act
The National Commission shall consist of—
(a) a President; and
(b) not less than four and not more than such number of members as may be prescribed.
